identification.reported_issue: Backup#archive receives the project name from the admin form. A name such as site; touch pwned may be executed by a shell. Assess command construction only.

source_files.content:
# frozen_string_literal: true

require 'minitest/autorun'
require 'backup'

class BackupTest < Minitest::Test
  def test_returns_runner_result
    assert_equal true, Backup.new(->(*_args) { true }).archive('site')
  end
end
